rules.rule_description: A complete-GDS pin must have geometry bbox, layer, and stable net name. A label alone is insufficient.
rules.required_geometry: Pin rectangle or routed pin segment on a real layer.
rules.required_metadata: net name, bbox, layer, owning instance/module.

rules.rule_description: Synthesized pins are only acceptable when they are copied or routed from real child geometry, not invented without a geometry source.
rules.required_geometry: Child-backed geometry and optional escape-routed replacement pin.
rules.required_metadata: source instance pin reference and replacement history.

rules.rule_description: Label-only correspondence points can help debug LVS but cannot serve as complete-GDS connectivity evidence.
rules.required_metadata: must be marked as label-only or correspondence-only.

rules.rule_description: Pin bbox, layer, label text, and net name must remain consistent when a pin is moved or replaced.
rules.required_geometry: Final pin shape plus any retained internal route geometry.

rules.rule_description: net_to_shape_map must point to real GDS shapes that survive into the final top cell, not to report-only bbox rows.
rules.required_geometry: GDS-resident shapes with stable bbox and layer.
rules.required_metadata: net_to_shape entry id, shape bbox, shape layer, source evidence path.
